name: Pavilions Place
demographics: Pavilions Place serves a diverse, affluent suburban market in Westminster and surrounding Orange County communities including Huntington Beach. The trade area features households with a median income of $95,757 within 1 mile, rising to $103,557 within 10 miles, with average household incomes exceeding $115,000-$134,000 across all radii. The center attracts middle to upper-middle class families and professionals, with a daytime population that significantly exceeds residential population, indicating strong employment centers nearby. The demographic profile shows a stable, established community with strong purchasing power typical of Orange County's coastal and near-coastal neighborhoods.
description: Pavilions Place is a prominent 209,749-square-foot community shopping center strategically located at 16400 Beach Boulevard in Westminster, California, serving the thriving Orange County communities of Westminster, Huntington Beach, and surrounding areas. The center benefits from exceptional visibility and convenient access to Interstate 405, one of Southern California's major transportation corridors, making it easily accessible to the region's affluent residential neighborhoods. With its well-maintained facilities and strong tenant mix, Pavilions Place has established itself as a reliable shopping destination for everyday needs and services in the heart of Orange County. The center's location in Westminster positions it within a prosperous trade area characterized by above-average household incomes and a substantial daytime population, reflecting the area's robust employment base. Managed by Kimco Realty Corporation, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers, Pavilions Place exemplifies quality community retail with professional management and ongoing tenant support services.
summary: Pavilions Place is a 209,749-square-foot community shopping center located on Beach Boulevard in Westminster, California, offering excellent visibility and convenient access to Interstate 405. The center serves the affluent Orange County communities of Westminster and Huntington Beach with a strong mix of retail and service tenants.
